source.test: createNewServer(name:...) -- archive-first gated on saveDownloadedJars and flavor == .paper

notes: The condition is `flavor == .paper && configManager.config.saveDownloadedJars` (line 258) -- both a Purpur download with the setting on, and a Paper download with `saveDownloadedJars` off, skip the metadata check entirely and go straight to `ServerJarProvider.downloadLatest`; this fixture exercises the flavor half of that AND, the sibling case for the setting-off half is implied by the same guard.
